question: Under the National Iron Plus Initiative (NIPI), all children aged 6–59 months receive a weekly oral iron-folic acid supplement of 20 mg elemental iron + 100 mcg folic acid.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is FALSE. The NIPI dose for children 6–59 months is syrup 25 mg elemental iron + 100 mcg folic acid, given TWICE weekly (not once weekly). The dose stated (20 mg weekly) is incorrect on both counts — check the programme schedule carefully.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is FALSE. The NIPI provides iron-folic acid supplementation for children 6–59 months as syrup containing 25 mg elemental iron + 100 mcg folic acid, given twice weekly (not weekly). Weekly supplementation applies to the 5–10 year and 10–19 year age groups under the extended Anaemia Mukt Bharat programme.
